Pricing

Last updated 14 September 2026 · Effective 14 September 2026

The short version. The whole game is free, everywhere. All 100 entries, all four stages, on the web and on iOS. There is no paid tier, no unlock, no subscription, no advertising, and nothing to buy.

1. Free edition — this website

Price: $0. Forever. Everything on devildictionary.com is playable without paying:

  • All 100 entries, across all four stages.
  • Stage II · The Judgment, where you must pick the true definition from three plausible ones.
  • Synthesised sound effects, Devil Coins, and progress saved between visits.
  • No account. No email address. No advertising. No tracking. Nothing is uploaded.

It runs in any modern browser on a phone, tablet or desktop, and there is also a single-file offline edition you can download once and keep forever — it works with no internet connection at all.

Play it free

2. Mobile edition coming soon

An iOS edition built for the App Store is in preparation. It is the same game at the same price as the website:

  • Free: all 100 entries, including Stage III · The Accomplice and Stage IV · The Author in full.
  • No in-app purchases of any kind. There is no unlock screen, no restore button, and no paywall — because there is nothing to unlock.

4. What you will never be charged for

  • No subscriptions. Nothing renews, so nothing needs cancelling.
  • No advertising. No ad SDKs, no video placements, no interrupts.
  • No consumables. No energy, no extra moves, no pay-to-win. The unlock buys content, never advantage.
  • No purchasable coins. Devil Coins are a trophy for completing words. They have no monetary value and cannot be bought at any price.
  • No paywall mid-puzzle. Nothing you are in the middle of solving is ever locked, on any platform.
  • Nothing to restore. Because the game is complete the moment you install it, there is no purchase to lose and nothing to recover.

5. Price, currency and tax

There is no price. The game costs nothing to play, and nothing in it can be bought at any price, in any currency, in any country.

6. Questions

Is there a free trial?

There is no trial, because there is nothing to try before buying. The entire game is free from the first word to the hundredth.

Will you ever add a paid tier?

Not for the entries already in the game. If a future edition ever adds paid content, the 100 entries available today stay free.

Are there refunds if nothing costs money?

There is nothing to refund, but the refund policy is published anyway, in case that ever changes.

Are my children safe in here?

The definitions are satirical and aimed at adults, but there is no advertising, no user-generated content, no chat, and no collection of personal data. See the privacy policy.
